title: Product category & applicable standards
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011 and the category-specific law named in the report
description: The commodity is classified first; only the rules and standards that govern that category are applied.

title: Package within the retail-declaration chapter
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 3 (as substituted by G.S.R. 629(E), 2017); Rule 2(bb), 2(bc) (G.S.R. 385(E), 2015)
description: Chapter II applies to retail packages up to 25 kg / 25 L (cement, fertiliser and farm produce up to 50 kg), not to packages marked 'not for retail sale' for industrial or institutional consumers.

title: Small-package exemption (10 g / 10 ml or less)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 26(a); provisos by G.S.R. 385(E), 2015 (tobacco) and G.S.R. 881(E), 2025 (pan masala, w.e.f. 01.02.2026)
description: Packages of 10 g / 10 ml or less are exempt, except tobacco products and pan masala, which must carry every declaration.

title: Export package not offered for sale in India
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 25
description: An export package may be sold in India only after it is re-packed or re-labelled to comply with Chapter II.

title: Name & complete address of manufacturer / packer
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(a); Rule 10(1) and Explanation 1 (as substituted 2017); QR proviso for electronic products (G.S.R. 456(E), 2023)
description: The name and complete address (street / premises, city, State and PIN code) of the manufacturer, and of the packer where different, must be declared.

title: Importer's name & address in India (imported goods)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(a); Rule 10(1) second proviso; Rule 6(9) (label on imported packages, 2015)
description: An imported package must declare the name and complete address of the importer in India.

title: Country of origin / manufacture / assembly (imported goods)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(aa) (inserted by G.S.R. 629(E), 2017)
description: Imported products must name the country of origin, manufacture or assembly.

title: Common or generic name of the commodity
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(b); QR proviso for electronic products (G.S.R. 456(E), 2023)
description: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared; for multi-product packages, the name and quantity of each product.

title: Contents of group, combination & multi-piece packages
description: Grouped, combination and multi-piece packs must state the number and quantity of each piece (e.g. 10 x 10 g), and each pack in a promotional group must itself comply with Rule 6.

title: Consumer care: name, address, telephone & e-mail
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(2) (as substituted w.e.f. 01.01.2016 by G.S.R. 385(E)); proviso for electronic products (G.S.R. 456(E), 2023)
description: The name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person or office to contact for consumer complaints must be declared.

title: Retail sale price (MRP) declared
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(e); Rule 2(m) (as substituted 2017); provisos: Rule 6(1)(g)(C) (bidi, APM LPG), State Excise laws (liquor)
description: The maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes must be declared on the package.

title: MRP shown as 'maximum retail price ... inclusive of all taxes' in Indian currency
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(e) (as amended by G.S.R. 629(E), 2017 and G.S.R. 779(E), 2021); Rule 2(m)
description: The price must be described as the maximum retail price, stated as inclusive of all taxes and expressed in Indian currency (Rs. / ₹).

title: Unit sale price declared
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(11) (G.S.R. 779(E), 2021, as substituted by G.S.R. 226(E), 2022; in force 01.01.2024); third proviso (G.S.R. 722(E), 2023)
description: The unit sale price must be declared on every pre-packaged commodity, except where it equals the MRP and for combination, group and multi-piece packages.

title: Unit sale price in the prescribed unit and correctly computed
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(11)(i)-(iv) (as substituted by G.S.R. 226(E), 2022)
description: Price per gram below 1 kg and per kilogram above 1 kg (per ml / litre, per cm / metre, per number likewise), rounded to two decimals, consistent with MRP / net quantity.

title: Single, unaltered MRP (no dual MRP or over-sticker)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(3) and proviso; Rule 18(2A) (G.S.R. 629(E), 2017); Rule 18(5)
description: Different MRPs must not be declared on an identical commodity, and stickers may not alter a declaration (only a lower-MRP sticker that leaves the original visible is allowed).

title: Net quantity declared in standard units
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(c); Rule 13(5) and Explanation ('L' for litre, 2015)
description: The net quantity must be declared in standard SI units of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, L, cm, m) or, for goods sold by number, as a number.

title: Unit appropriate to the declared quantity
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 13(2) and 13(3)
description: Quantities below 1 kg / 1 L / 1 m are declared in g / ml / cm; quantities of 1 kg / 1 L / 1 m and above in kg / L / m (decimal fractions allowed).

title: Quantity declared in the measure prescribed for the commodity
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 12(1), 12(2); Fourth Schedule (as amended up to G.S.R. 722(E), 2023)
description: Solids by mass, liquids by volume, goods sold by number by number, unless the Fourth Schedule prescribes otherwise for the commodity (e.g. honey and ice cream by weight, paints by volume, garments by number).

title: Volume declaration also gives the weight (edible oils, vanaspati, ghee)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Fourth Schedule item 11 (as substituted by G.S.R. 722(E), 06.10.2023, w.e.f. 01.01.2024)
description: Where the net quantity of edible oil, vanaspati, ghee or butter oil is declared by volume, it must also be declared by weight.

title: No misleading words in the quantity declaration
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 12(6) (as amended w.e.f. 01.07.2012 by G.S.R. 748(E)); Rule 11(2), 11(3)
description: The quantity declaration must not be qualified by words such as 'minimum', 'not less than', 'average', 'about' or 'approximately'.

title: 'When packed' only for Third Schedule commodities
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 11(2)-(4); Third Schedule (soaps, lotions, creams; camphor added 2015)
description: Only soaps, lotions, creams (other than cream of milk) and camphor may qualify the quantity with 'when packed'.

title: Number declared as N / U / pieces; no dozen, score or gross
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 13(4); Rule 13(5)(ii) (as substituted by G.S.R. 779(E), 2021)
description: Goods sold by number declare the count as number, unit, piece, pair or set; 'dozen', 'score', 'gross' and the like are not permitted.

title: Month & year of manufacture
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(d) (as amended by G.S.R. 779(E), 2021 and G.S.R. 722(E), 2023); exemptions in Rule 6(1)(g)(A) and the Seeds Act proviso
description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured must be declared (electronic products, spare parts and accessories: anywhere on the retail package).

title: Best before / use-by / expiry date
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(da) (inserted by G.S.R. 629(E), 2017); FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020; Cosmetics Rules, 2020; Medical Devices Rules, 2017
description: A commodity that may become unfit for consumption or use after a period must state its best before, use-by or expiry date.

title: Dates consistent and product within shelf life
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(d), 6(1)(da); Rule 18(1)
description: The manufacture date must not be in the future, the best before / expiry must fall after it, and expired stock must not be offered for sale.

title: Height of numerals & letters for the display-panel area
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 7(2), 7(3), Table-I (as substituted by G.S.R. 629(E), 2017; corrigendum G.S.R. 1373(E)); Rule 7(4) area method
description: Minimum height of numerals and letters by principal display panel area: up to 50 cm² 1 mm, 50-100 cm² 1.5 mm, 100-500 cm² 2.5 mm, 500-2500 cm² 4 mm, above 2500 cm² 6 mm (larger when blown, formed or moulded).

title: Declarations legible and in a contrasting colour
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 9(1)(a), 9(1)(b)
description: Every declaration must be legible and prominent, and the MRP and net-quantity numerals must contrast conspicuously with the background.

title: Declarations in Hindi (Devanagari) or English
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 9(4)
description: Declarations must be in Hindi in Devanagari script or in English; other languages may be used in addition.

title: Batch / lot / code number
reference: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020; Cosmetics Rules, 2020; Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 (r.96, r.161); Medical Devices Rules, 2017 (r.44); Insecticides Rules, 1971 (r.19)
applies_to: tag:food tag:cosmetic tag:drug tag:ayush tag:medical_device tag:insecticide
description: A batch, lot or code number identifying the production run must be declared.

title: FSSAI logo and 14-digit licence / registration number
reference: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, s.31; FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020
description: Every food package must display the FSSAI logo with the 14-digit licence or registration number of the brand owner / manufacturer.

title: Vegetarian / non-vegetarian symbol
reference: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020
description: A green dot in a green square (vegetarian) or a brown triangle / dot in a brown square (non-vegetarian) must appear on the principal display panel.

title: List of ingredients
reference: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020
description: Except single-ingredient foods, the label must list the ingredients in descending order of weight.

title: Nutritional information
reference: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020
description: Energy (kcal), protein, carbohydrate, total sugars, added sugars, total fat and sodium per 100 g / 100 ml (and per serve) must be declared.

title: Allergen declaration
reference: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020
description: Where cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, milk, eggs, fish, peanuts, tree nuts, soy or sulphite are present, they must be declared as allergens.

title: 'Mother's milk is best for your baby' notice
reference: Infant Milk Substitutes, Feeding Bottles and Infant Foods Act, 1992, s.6; FSS (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations, 2020
params: {"patterns":["mother'?s\\s*milk\\s*is\\s*(the\\s*)?best","breast\\s*milk\\s*is\\s*(the\\s*)?best"],"what":"the 'IMPORTANT NOTICE: Mother's milk is best for your baby' statement"}
description: Infant milk substitutes and infant foods must carry the statement 'IMPORTANT NOTICE: Mother's milk is best for your baby' in capital letters.

title: Recommended age for infant food
reference: FSS (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations, 2020
params: {"patterns":["\\b\\d+\\s*(\\+|plus)?\\s*months?\\b","from\\s+\\d+\\s*months","(age|suitable)\\s*(group|for)?\\s*[:\\-]?\\s*\\d+"],"what":"the age from which the food is to be used"}
description: Infant foods must state the age (in months) from which they are recommended.

title: Pan masala health warning
reference: FSS (Labelling & Display) Regulations, 2020; FSS (Prohibition & Restrictions on Sales) Regulations, 2011
params: {"patterns":["chewing\\s*of\\s*pan\\s*masala\\s*is\\s*injurious\\s*to\\s*health","pan\\s*masala\\s*is\\s*injurious\\s*to\\s*health"],"what":"the warning 'Chewing of pan masala is injurious to health'"}
description: Pan masala packages must carry the warning 'Chewing of pan masala is injurious to health'.

title: Statutory alcohol warnings
reference: FSS (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2018 (labelling)
params: {"all":["consumption\\s*of\\s*alcohol\\s*is\\s*injurious\\s*to\\s*health","(don'?t|do\\s*not)\\s*drink\\s*(&|and)\\s*drive"],"what":"'Consumption of alcohol is injurious to health' and 'Be safe - don't drink and drive'"}
description: Alcoholic beverages must carry 'Consumption of alcohol is injurious to health' and 'Be safe - don't drink and drive'.

title: Alcohol strength declared (% v/v)
reference: FSS (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2018 (labelling)
params: {"patterns":["\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\s*%\\s*(v\\s*/\\s*v|abv|alc|vol)","alc(ohol)?\\.?\\s*(content)?\\s*[:\\-]?\\s*\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\s*%","\\babv\\s*[:\\-]?\\s*\\d"],"what":"the alcohol content in % v/v"}
description: The alcohol content must be declared as percentage by volume.

title: 'NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE' (health supplements)
reference: FSS (Health Supplements, Nutraceuticals, Food for Special Dietary Use, ... ) Regulations, 2016 (labelling)
params: {"patterns":["not\\s*for\\s*medicinal\\s*use"],"what":"the words 'NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE'"}
description: Health supplements and nutraceuticals must state 'NOT FOR MEDICINAL USE' prominently.

title: Caffeine advisory (caffeinated beverages)
reference: FSS (Food Products Standards & Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 - caffeinated beverages
params: {"trigger_what":"a caffeine declaration or the words 'energy drink'","trigger":["caffeine","energy\\s*drink"],"patterns":["not\\s*recommended\\s*for\\s*(children|pregnant|lactating)","pregnant\\s*or\\s*lactating"],"what":"the advisory 'Not recommended for children, pregnant or lactating women, persons sensitive to caffeine'"}
description: Caffeinated beverages must declare the caffeine content and the advisory for children, pregnant or lactating women and caffeine-sensitive persons.

title: Genetically modified food marked 'GM'
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(7) (inserted by the Third Amendment Rules 2011, G.S.R. 784(E), w.e.f. 01.01.2013)
params: {"trigger_what":"a genetically modified ingredient","trigger":["genetically\\s*modified","\\bGMOs?\\b","\\bGM\\s*(food|ingredient|soy|soya|maize|corn|canola|cotton)"],"patterns":["(?<![A-Za-z])G\\.?\\s?M\\.?(?![A-Za-z])"],"what":"the words 'GM' at the top of the principal display panel"}
description: Every package containing genetically modified food must bear the words 'GM' at the top of its principal display panel.

title: Specified health warning on the pack
reference: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003, s.7; COTPA (Packaging and Labelling) Rules, 2008, as amended
params: {"patterns":["tobacco\\s*causes\\s*(painful\\s*death|cancer)","smoking\\s*(kills|causes)","tobacco\\s*kills","injurious\\s*to\\s*health","tobacco\\s*users\\s*die\\s*younger"],"what":"the specified health warning text"}
description: Every tobacco pack must carry the specified pictorial health warning and its text.

title: Tobacco quit-line number
reference: COTPA (Packaging and Labelling) Rules, 2008, as amended (quitline 1800-11-2356)
params: {"patterns":["1800[\\s\\-]*11[\\s\\-]*2356","quit\\s*today"],"what":"the quit-line 'Quit today call 1800-11-2356'"}
description: The specified health warning includes the quit-line number 1800-11-2356.

title: Health warning covers 85% of the principal display area
reference: COTPA (Packaging and Labelling) Rules, 2008, r.3 (as amended)
params: {"ai_key":"tobacco_warning_coverage_pct","min":85,"what":"the pictorial warning covering at least 85% of the front and back panels"}
description: The pictorial health warning must cover at least 85% of the principal display area of the front and back of the pack.

title: Manufacturing licence / import registration number
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940; Cosmetics Rules, 2020 (labelling)
params: {"kind":"cosmetic"}
description: Cosmetics must show the manufacturing licence number, or the import registration certificate number for imported cosmetics.

title: List of ingredients
reference: Cosmetics Rules, 2020 (labelling)
description: Cosmetics must list their ingredients.

title: Vegetarian / non-vegetarian dot (optional)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(4A)(d) (inserted, and Rule 6(8) omitted, by the Fourth Amendment Rules, 21.09.2026)
description: Soaps, shampoos, toothpaste, cosmetics and toiletries may carry a green (vegetarian) or red / brown (non-vegetarian) dot at the top of the principal display panel; since 21.09.2026 it is optional.

title: Manufacturer's name & address
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.96(1)
description: Medicines must carry the name and address of the manufacturer.

title: Drug manufacturing licence number
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.96(1)
params: {"kind":"drug"}
description: The manufacturing licence number, prefixed 'Mfg. Lic. No.' / 'M.L.', must appear on the label.

title: Proper name and strength of the drug
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.96(1)
params: {"patterns":["each\\s*(film[\\s\\-]*coated\\s*|uncoated\\s*|enteric[\\s\\-]*coated\\s*)?(tablet|capsule|ml|5\\s*ml|gram|g)\\s*contains","\\b(i\\.?\\s?p\\.?|b\\.?\\s?p\\.?|u\\.?\\s?s\\.?\\s?p\\.?)\\b","\\d+\\s*mg\\b"],"what":"the proper name of the drug with its strength (e.g. 'Each tablet contains Paracetamol IP 500 mg')"}
description: The proper (pharmacopoeial) name and the content of each active ingredient per unit must be stated.

title: Net content
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.96(1)
description: The net content (number of tablets / capsules, volume or weight) must be declared.

title: Date of manufacture
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.96(1)
description: The date of manufacture must be declared.

title: Date of expiry
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.96(1)
description: The date of expiry of potency must be declared.

title: Maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes
reference: Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013, para 24
description: Every pack of a formulation must display its maximum retail price, preceded by 'M.R.P.', inclusive of all taxes.

title: Schedule H / H1 / X caution
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.97
params: {"trigger_what":"a Schedule H / H1 / X or Rx marking","trigger":["schedule\\s*h1?\\b","schedule\\s*x\\b","\\brx\\b"],"patterns":["to\\s*be\\s*sold\\s*by\\s*retail\\s*on\\s*the\\s*prescription","prescription\\s*of\\s*a\\s*registered\\s*medical\\s*practitioner"],"what":"the caution 'To be sold by retail on the prescription of a Registered Medical Practitioner only'"}
description: Schedule H, H1 and X drugs must carry the Rx symbol and the prescribed caution in a box.

title: AYUSH manufacturing licence number
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.161
params: {"kind":"ayush"}
description: Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani medicines must carry the manufacturing licence number.

title: 'Ayurvedic / Siddha / Unani medicine' declared
reference: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, r.161
params: {"patterns":["ayurvedic\\s*(proprietary\\s*)?medicine","siddha\\s*(proprietary\\s*)?medicine","unani\\s*(proprietary\\s*)?medicine","homoeopathic\\s*medicine","for\\s*(internal|external)\\s*use"],"what":"the words 'Ayurvedic / Siddha / Unani Medicine' (or 'Proprietary Medicine')"}
description: The label must state that it is an Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani (proprietary) medicine.

title: Medical device licence number
reference: Medical Devices Rules, 2017, r.44; LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 26(c) proviso
params: {"kind":"medical_device"}
description: Medical devices must carry the manufacturing or import licence number (Form MD-5 / MD-9 / MD-15).

title: Consumer care telephone and e-mail on the package itself
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(2) proviso (G.S.R. 577(E), 2022, as substituted by G.S.R. 456(E), 2023)
description: Electronic products may move other details to a QR code, but the telephone number and e-mail must be printed on the package.

title: BIS standard mark for a Quality Control Order product
reference: BIS Act, 2016, s.16-17 and the Quality Control Order / CRS Order notified for the product
description: Products notified under a Quality Control Order or the Compulsory Registration Scheme must carry the ISI mark with the IS number and licence (CM/L-) or the BIS Standard Mark with the R-number.

title: Garment size in metric notation (cm / m)
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 26(f)(iii) (as substituted by G.S.R. 722(E), 2023); Rule 12(4); Advisory on readymade garments
description: Garments must state their size in cm or m, optionally with S / M / L / XL indicators.

title: Number and finished dimensions of each piece
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 14
params: {"require_count":true,"what":"the number of pieces and the finished size of each (e.g. 2 pillow covers 46 cm x 69 cm)"}
description: Bed-sheets, fabrics, dhoties, sarees, napkins, pillow covers, towels and table cloths must declare the number and the finished dimensions of each piece.

title: Size / dimensions declared where size is relevant
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(f); Rule 15
description: Where the size of the commodity is relevant to the purchase (tyres, footwear, helmets), it must be declared.

title: Number of usable sheets and size of each sheet
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 16
description: Tissues, toilet rolls, foil, wax paper and similar sheet goods must declare the number of usable sheets and the dimensions of each sheet.

title: Number of containers and their dimensions
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 17
params: {"require_count":true,"what":"the number of bags / cups / containers followed by their dimensions or capacity"}
description: Bags, boxes, cups, plates and containers sold empty must declare their number followed by length x width (x depth) or diameter.

title: Insecticide registration number
reference: Insecticides Act, 1968, s.9; Insecticides Rules, 1971, r.19
params: {"kind":"insecticide"}
description: Insecticides must show their registration number (CIR) and manufacturing licence number.

title: Warning, antidote & 'keep out of reach of children'
reference: Insecticides Rules, 1971, r.19
params: {"patterns":["keep\\s*(out\\s*of|away\\s*from)\\s*(the\\s*)?reach\\s*of\\s*children","antidote","\\bpoison\\b","first\\s*aid","\\bwarning\\b|\\bcaution\\b"],"what":"the warning / caution, first-aid and antidote statements"}
description: Insecticide labels must carry the prescribed warning, first-aid and antidote statements.

title: Fertiliser grade & nutrient content
reference: Fertiliser (Control) Order, 1985, cl.21 (marking of bags)
description: Fertiliser bags must state the name, grade and nutrient content of the fertiliser.

title: Seed germination & purity declared
reference: Seeds Act, 1966, s.6-7; Seeds Rules, 1968
params: {"all":["germination","purity"],"what":"the germination percentage and physical purity"}
description: Seed packets must state the kind and variety, germination and physical purity (and the certification tag where certified).

title: Wholesale package: name & address of manufacturer / packer / importer
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 24(a)
description: Every wholesale package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, importer or packer.

title: Wholesale package: identity of the commodity
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 24(b)
description: Every wholesale package must declare the identity of the commodity it contains.

title: Wholesale package: number of retail packages or net quantity
reference: LM (PC) Rules 2011, Rule 24(c)
description: Every wholesale package must declare the total number of retail packages or the net quantity in standard units.

title: MRP matches the case record
reference: Case cross-check (LM Act 2009, s.36; Rule 18(2))
description: The MRP on the pack must match the MRP recorded for the case / product.

title: Net quantity matches the declared product
reference: Case cross-check (LM Act 2009, s.30)
description: The net quantity on the pack must match the quantity recorded for the product under inspection.

title: Evidence image quality
reference: ComplyVision evidence standard
description: The captured image must be sharp, evenly lit and readable for an automated decision.
